label: Tangerang
short_description: Jakarta's western satellite spanning Tangerang city, Soekarno-Hatta Airport, and the planned townships of BSD City, Serpong, Alam Sutera, and Gading Serpong.
intro: Tangerang lies immediately west of Jakarta and covers both older Tangerang city -- built around the Cisadane River and the Tangcity mall district -- and the newer planned townships of South Tangerang: BSD City, Serpong, Alam Sutera, and Gading Serpong. These townships have grown into self-contained business and lifestyle hubs of their own, with malls like AEON and Summarecon Mall Serpong, the ICE BSD convention center, and a resident and commuter population that treats them as distinct destinations from both central Jakarta and the immediate airport zone. Soekarno-Hatta International Airport sits within the broader Tangerang area, and central Jakarta is typically 45 minutes to an hour away by toll road depending on traffic and which township a hotel sits in.
